bio: I love to build new acquisition channels and run paid campaigns end-to-end: from creative angles and scriptwriting to tracking, analytics, and performance measurement.

Managed B2B and SaaS acquisition across Meta, Google, and LinkedIn Ads with end-to-end GA4/GTM analytics.
Managed paid advertising, SEO, and social media campaigns across startups and SMEs.
